scope: Reviewed OpenTS source-model payload inventory for retained DTA weapons; not installed-binary, target eligibility, cadence or geometry certification.
railgun_rule: TechnoClass::Railgun_Beam_Damage collects unique target objects, then applies weapon AmbientDamage once per collected object using the weapon warhead. It adds the explicit target if absent. Obstructed paths can terminate before damage; unobstructed eligible impact is assumed for nominal payload arithmetic.
particle_rule: Smoke_Behavior_AI and Railgun_Behavior_AI do not apply health damage. Inspected held particle types have no Damage or NextParticle override; constructor defaults are Damage=0 and NextParticle=NONE. The listed particle sections have no Enhance override.

unmodeled_special_weapons.HornetLauncher: Spawner=yes; authored Damage=1 does not represent spawned aircraft attacks.
unmodeled_special_weapons.Suicide: Suicide=yes and Damage=0; death/animation payload cannot be treated as zero combat damage.

projectile_defaults.note: These are authored projectile/attack parameters, not proof of collateral immunity. Do not reuse them as universal damage-target masks without reviewing impact behavior.

limitations: This inventory does not authorize replacing the frozen reference metric or applying gameplay stats.
Other or changed attached particle systems need their own disposition; do not generalize the zero-payload ruling by name similarity.
Direct bullet damage and ambient beam damage remain separately evidenced contributions before armor; geometry and secondary victims are not multiplied into nominal single-target payload.
